General Disclaimer

When interacting with the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) Virtual Assistant, please do not include any personal information.

When your chat is over, you can save the transcript. Use caution when using a public computer or device.

Third-Party Translation Disclaimer

The DMV chatbot and live chat services use third-party vendors to provide machine translation. Machine translation is provided for purposes of information and convenience only. The DMV is unable to guarantee the accuracy of any translation provided by the third-party vendors and is therefore not liable for any inaccurate information or changes in the formatting of the content resulting from the use of the translation service.

The content currently in English is the official and accurate source for the program information and services DMV provides. Any discrepancies or differences created in the translation are not binding and have no legal effect for compliance or enforcement purposes. If any questions arise related to the information contained in the translated content, please refer to the English version.

    • Driver’s License & ID Card Online Renewal

    Driver’s License & ID Card Online Renewal

    If you are age 70+ and renewing your driver’s license, you might not need to take a test. Check your renewal notice to be sure.

    I need to…

    Renew

    Select this option if you have either a:
    Standard driver’s license/ID or
    REAL ID driver’s license/ID


    Renew Driver’s License/ID

    Convert to a REAL ID

    Select this option to convert to a REAL ID while renewing a:
    Standard driver’s license/ID


    Convert to REAL ID

    Renew at a DMV office

    Select this option if you have either a:
    Standard driver’s license/ID or
    REAL ID driver’s license/ID
    and received a notice to renew at a DMV office. You can start the renewal online and save time at your office visit.

    Are you over age 70? Review the Guide to Driver’s License Renewal for 70+. Save time when you visit the office by starting your renewal online.

    Start Online / Finish at Office

    Renew Commercial Driver's License

    Select this option if you have a:
    Commercial driver’s license

    Make sure your address and personal information are up to date before you start.

    Note: Temporarily unavailable online.

    Check my Driver's License/ID status

    Already renewed? You should receive your new DL/ID card in the mail within two to four weeks. If you have not received your DL/ID card after 60 days, check your status online. 


    Check Driver’s License/ID Status

    Get future renewal notices by email

    Sign up for Paperless Notices to get your DL/ID renewal notices electronically and save paper. You can update your preferences at any time.

    Go Paperless

    Save time!

    When renewing your driver’s license online, you may be required to complete the online eLearning course to satisfy your knowledge test requirement.

    • eLearning (Recommended!): For DL renewals only. This all-pass, no-fail, interactive online course is short, fast, and entertaining. Complete the course any time of day or night using the device of your choice (computer, laptop, tablet, or smartphone). Currently available in English, Spanish, and Traditional Chinese (with audio in Mandarin).
    Learn More

    Updating your information before you renew:

    I need to change my address

    An address should be updated at least five days prior to renewing your DL/ID.

    If you already submitted a change of address request, you can check your status online.

    Change my address

    I need to change my name or gender identity

    Name or gender identity changes must be processed at a DMV office. Before you go, start by completing a new application online.

    Update my information

    I need to change other information

    If you have other changes to your DL/ID information, such as height and weight, you will need to fill out a new application and visit a DMV office.

    Start application
